world.title: Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia sign defence cooperation accord, Ankara says
world.summary: Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed a defence cooperation agreement on Wednesday, aimed at enhancing their defensive capabilities, according to the Turkish Defence Ministry. The accord is intended to strengthen military collaboration among the four nations. This agreement reflects a commitment to mutual security and support in defence matters, as stated by officials from the participating countries.

world.title: Donald Trump Goes Into Graphic Detail About US Senator Jon Husted's Body
world.summary: During a rally in Greenville, North Carolina, former President Donald Trump made graphic comments about Ohio Senator Jon Husted's physique while supporting Republican Senate candidate Michael Whatley. Trump expressed admiration for Husted's body, stating he was "studying" it, which drew attention due to the unusual nature of his remarks. Husted is currently campaigning in the midterms.

world.title: Vivek Ramaswamy heckled at campaign event in Ohio over controversial ad featuring Amy Acton's estranged mother
world.summary: Vivek Ramaswamy, a Republican gubernatorial candidate in Ohio, faced heckling at a campaign event due to a controversial ad featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent, Amy Acton. The ad includes accusations from Donna Arthur, claiming her daughter has lied. The incident highlights growing criticism surrounding the campaign strategy as tensions rise in the gubernatorial race.

business.title: Top 10 Scooters September 2026 India - Activa, Jupiter, Access, iQube
business.summary: In September 2026, Honda Activa achieved a record market share of nearly 42 percent in India’s scooter segment. The total sales for the top 10 scooters reached 842,293 units, reflecting a robust year-over-year growth of 32.5 percent. Other popular models included Jupiter, Access, and iQube, contributing to the overall increase in scooter sales during the month.

business.title: Core sector output growth hits 30-month high of 7.9% in September, driven by coal, power
business.summary: India's core sector output growth reached 7.9% in September 2026, the highest in 30 months, up from a revised 5.9% in August. Six of the nine core industries experienced expansion, primarily due to significant increases in coal and power production. However, fertiliser production continued to decline, marking its seventh consecutive month of contraction.

business.title: FX Daily: Dollar shows fresh vulnerability to oil price drops
business.summary: The dollar is exhibiting weakness, influenced by recent fluctuations in oil prices and lingering concerns over AI-related issues, particularly following CoreWeave bond instability. Despite this, the EUR/USD remains stable, even as French spreads widen. Market dynamics indicate a potential unwinding of overvalued short-term positions, contributing to the dollar's vulnerability in the current trading environment.

technology.title: Spotify cracking down on users sharing family plan who don't live in same household
technology.summary: Spotify is tightening its policies on family plan accounts, warning users that sharing accounts with individuals outside the same household will be restricted. The family plan, which accommodates up to six users, is intended for those living at the same address. This move aims to ensure compliance with the service's terms and conditions regarding account sharing.

technology.title: Football Manager 27 free launch preview - Date, platform & everything you need to know
technology.summary: Football Manager 27 will be available for free from October 29 at 6 PM GMT until November 3, 2026, on PC and Mac. Players can download the game during this period to experience the launch preview. Sports Interactive has confirmed these details, providing an opportunity for fans to engage with the game before its official release.

technology.title: Next-Generation Xbox Console Could Cost Rs 1.7 Lakh: Report
technology.summary: The next-generation Xbox console, codenamed 'Project Helix', is estimated to cost between $1,200 (Rs 1.13 lakh) and $1,800 (Rs 1.69 lakh), according to internal estimates. Asha Sharma, who recently succeeded Phil Spencer as Microsoft Gaming CEO, announced the console. Details regarding its specifications and development progress have not yet been disclosed, as reported by Fortune.

sports.title: Four issues Man Utd boss Michael Carrick must overcome against Como after 'toxic culture' claim
sports.summary: Manchester United will face Como in the Champions League on Wednesday, with manager Michael Carrick under significant pressure following claims of a "toxic culture" within the club. Carrick must address four key issues to secure a much-needed victory, as United has only won two of their last ten matches across all competitions, intensifying the urgency for a positive result.

sports.title: Steve Smith joins Ricky Ponting, Allan Border in elite Australian club, fifth-fastest to 11K Test runs
sports.summary: Steve Smith achieved a significant milestone by becoming the third Australian and the 12th player globally to score 11,000 runs in Test cricket. This accomplishment occurred during the second Test against South Africa. Smith joins legends Ricky Ponting and Allan Border in this elite group, marking him as the fifth-fastest player to reach this landmark in Test history.

sports.title: ‘Gutless’: Aussies ‘throw in the towel’ as follow-on disaster has stars ‘playing for their careers’
sports.summary: Australia's batting performance at St George’s Park has been criticized as "pretty gutless" by former South African bowler Vernon Philander. The team faces pressure, with players reportedly "playing for their careers" following a disappointing follow-on. Despite the absence of injured star Steve Smith, the Australian squad's struggles have raised concerns about their future performance and competitiveness.

health.title: Why OR air purification fails to reduce surgical infections
health.summary: A study involving over 110,000 surgeries revealed that advanced air purification and sterilization systems in operating rooms did not lower rates of surgical site infections, postoperative complications, or mortality. The findings indicate that hospitals should prioritize preventing direct contamination of surgical wounds instead. This research was published in the journal Anesthesiology, highlighting ongoing concerns about surgical site infections.

health.title: Researchers identify subtype of depression linked to body's internal clock
health.summary: Researchers have identified a new subtype of depression termed 'circadian depression', associated with the body's 24-hour internal clock that regulates sleep-wake cycles. This discovery, resulting from clinical and genetic analyses, may impact treatment efficacy and patient outcomes. Understanding this subtype could lead to more tailored approaches in managing depression, enhancing the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions.

health.title: As Ebola spreads in Congo, grieving families face a growing mental health toll
health.summary: Ebola's resurgence in eastern Congo is causing significant psychological distress among grieving families, exacerbated by stigma and fear. A schoolteacher, whose five relatives were diagnosed, expressed deep concern for their well-being. The outbreak disrupts traditional mourning practices, intensifying the emotional burden. Families face isolation and heightened anxiety as they navigate the challenges posed by the disease and community perceptions.

science.title: 5 surprising health benefits of playing volleyball
science.summary: Playing volleyball provides several health benefits beyond enjoyment. The sport promotes cardiovascular health through constant movement, including sprints, jumps, and lateral actions that elevate heart rates. This aerobic activity strengthens heart muscles and enhances circulation. Additionally, volleyball can improve coordination, boost mental health, and foster social connections, making it a comprehensive exercise option for overall well-being.

science.title: Why Nasa astronauts are studying tumours, printing blood vessels in space
science.summary: NASA astronauts on the International Space Station (ISS) are conducting research on cancer and printing blood vessel cells. This work aims to advance medical knowledge and improve healthcare on Earth. The experiments in microgravity may provide insights into tumor behavior and vascular development, potentially benefiting future space missions and contributing to advancements in medical treatments for various conditions.

science.title: NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover just shattered the all-time off-world driving record
science.summary: NASA’s Perseverance rover has set a new record for off-world driving, surpassing Opportunity’s 28.06-mile mark in just five and a half years. This achievement, reached on its 2,006th Martian day, highlights Perseverance's advanced self-driving capabilities. The rover is currently exploring some of the oldest rocks in the solar system, seeking evidence of ancient Martian environments that may have supported life.

entertainment.title: Arijit Singh’s ₹11.8 lakh concert package sells out fast; Diljit Dosanjh keeps ticket prices capped at ₹18,000
entertainment.summary: Arijit Singh and Diljit Dosanjh are set to perform across India, with significant differences in ticket prices. Arijit’s highest concert package is priced at ₹11.8 lakh and has sold out quickly. In contrast, Diljit has limited his top ticket price to ₹18,000, making it more accessible for fans. Both artists aim to reach diverse audiences nationwide.

entertainment.title: 'He Embarrassed Her': Vijay Deverakonda Trolled For Saying Rashmika Mandanna Asked Him To Marry Her '100 Times'
entertainment.summary: Rashmika Mandanna disclosed that she proposed marriage to Vijay Deverakonda multiple times over a year before they decided to tie the knot. This revelation was made in the trailer for the upcoming episode of "Koffee With Karan 9." The discussion has led to mixed reactions online, with some comparing it to the relationship dynamics of Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, October 22, 2026: On this day, a change in perspective may reveal an option you had not previously considered
entertainment.summary: On October 22, 2026, horoscopes suggest a shift in perspective may uncover previously overlooked options. The day encourages individuals to detach from distractions and reflect on essential matters. Clarity may arise through independent work or reevaluating personal decisions. Emphasis is placed on allowing oneself to progress at a comfortable pace, rather than adhering to external pressures or expectations.
